name: The Rain was Ending, and Light
source:
This visual novel was inspired by a poem with the same title by Laurence Binyon. A boy, no older then seven, lying on a bed watches the first rainfall the town has had in twenty years. 

[From [url=http://weouxus.weebly.com/]Weouxus[/url]]
translation:
本作灵感来自劳伦斯·比尼恩的同名诗歌。一个不超过七岁的男孩躺在床上，望着小镇二十年来的第一场雨。

[译自 [url=http://weouxus.weebly.com/]Weouxus[/url]]
